scope: Each script runs the same synthetic lifecycle twice, once with full replay and once with the incremental external session: one perpetual account, a closed one-minute bar per call, every order filled at once at its price (or the close) and acknowledged on the next call. A script qualifies only when every response and every durable state is identical in both modes, over each price path, without errors. This qualifies the incremental path against replay for these inputs; it is not a trading or market qualification.
